nodes.description: msg.sender - caller-controlled address used for authorization (owner checks) and allowance accounting throughout ETHPRO
owner - privileged address set in constructor from msg.sender; gates delegate, _mints, init, batchSend, setTradeAddress
balanceOf - public mapping of token balances mutated by transferFrom, _mints and batchSend
allowance - public nested mapping of approvals mutated by approve and transferFrom
totalSupply - total token supply assigned in constructor
tradeAddress - privileged whitelist address set by setTradeAddress and trusted in ensure
_onSaleNum - per-address sale counter incremented in transferFrom and read by condition
canSale - whitelist mapping granting sale bypass, set by _mints and read by ensure
_minSale - minimum transfer amount configured by init and read by condition
_maxSale - maximum transfer amount configured by init and read by condition
_saleNum - allowed number of sales configured by init and read by condition
decimals - constant 18 used for scaling in _mints, init and constructor
name - token name set in constructor
symbol - token symbol set in constructor
UNI - constant Uniswap router address whitelisted in ensure
transfer(address _to, uint _value) payable - forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value)
ensure(address _from, address _to, uint _value) internal view - whitelist check plus condition() requirement
transferFrom(address _from, address _to, uint _value) payable - allowance deduction, ensure check and raw balance arithmetic
approve(address _spender, uint _value) payable - writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender]
condition(address _from, uint _value) internal view - enforces _saleNum, _minSale, _maxSale sale limits
delegate(address a, bytes memory b) payable - owner-only delegatecall to an arbitrary address
_mints(address spender, uint256 addedValue) - privileged mint/whitelist assigning balanceOf and canSale
init(uint256 saleNum, uint256 token, uint256 maxToken) - owner-only sale parameter configuration
batchSend(address[] _tos, uint _value) payable - owner-only loop distributing balances with unchecked arithmetic
setTradeAddress(address addr) - owner-only setter for tradeAddress whitelist
pairFor(address factory, address tokenA, address tokenB) internal pure - deterministic Uniswap pair address computation
constructor(string _name, string _symbol, uint256 _supply) payable - initializes metadata, supply, owner and infinite UNI allowance
a.delegatecall(b) - executes arbitrary attacker-supplied bytecode in the context of ETHPRO storage
balanceOf[_from] -= _value in transferFrom - unchecked subtraction without SafeMath
balanceOf[_to] += _value in transferFrom - unchecked addition without SafeMath
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value in transferFrom - unchecked allowance deduction
balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total in batchSend - unchecked subtraction without SafeMath
balanceOf[_to] += _value in batchSend loop - unchecked addition without SafeMath
uint total = _value * _tos.length in batchSend - multiplication that can overflow
balanceOf[spender] = addedValue*(10**uint256(decimals)) in _mints - overwriting assignment with unchecked multiplication
_to - recipient parameter of transfer
_value - amount parameter of transfer
_from - source parameter of transferFrom
_to - recipient parameter of transferFrom
_value - amount parameter of transferFrom
_spender - spender parameter of approve
_value - amount parameter of approve
_from - source parameter of ensure
_to - recipient parameter of ensure
_value - amount parameter of ensure
_from - address parameter of condition
_value - amount parameter of condition
a - target address parameter of delegate
b - calldata bytes parameter of delegate passed to delegatecall
spender - recipient parameter of _mints
addedValue - mint amount parameter of _mints
saleNum - sale count parameter of init
token - minimum sale parameter of init
maxToken - maximum sale parameter of init
_tos - recipient array parameter of batchSend
_value - per-recipient amount parameter of batchSend
total - product of _value and _tos.length in batchSend
i - loop index of batchSend

edges.reason: msg.sender indexes allowance[_from][msg.sender] inside transferFrom
msg.sender keys the allowance mapping written by approve
transfer forwards msg.sender as the token source to transferFrom
batchSend requires msg.sender == owner before distributing balances
delegate requires msg.sender == owner before performing the delegatecall
_mints requires msg.sender to be owner or a hardcoded address
init requires msg.sender == owner before setting sale parameters
setTradeAddress requires msg.sender == owner before whitelisting
constructor assigns owner = msg.sender
ensure trusts msg.sender-originated _from/_to against owner and whitelist addresses
owner is read in the require(msg.sender == owner) guard of delegate
owner gates the privileged mint and whitelist write in _mints
owner gates reconfiguration of sale limits in init
owner gates the balance redistribution loop in batchSend
owner gates mutation of the tradeAddress whitelist
ensure compares _from/_to to owner to bypass the sale condition
constructor writes owner
transferFrom reads and writes balanceOf for both parties
batchSend debits and credits balanceOf entries
_mints overwrites balanceOf[spender]
transferFrom checks and decrements allowance
approve writes the allowance mapping
ensure treats tradeAddress as a whitelisted sender
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from]
condition compares _onSaleNum[_from] against _saleNum
ensure grants bypass when canSale[_from] is true
_mints sets canSale[spender] = true
condition reads _minSale to bound transfer value
condition reads _maxSale to bound transfer value
condition reads _saleNum to limit sale count
init writes _saleNum
constructor sets totalSupply from _supply
_mints scales addedValue by 10**decimals
init scales token and maxToken by 10**decimals
constructor scales _supply by 10**decimals
transfer calls transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value)
transferFrom requires ensure(_from, _to, _value) via require
ensure calls pairFor to derive the Uniswap pair address
ensure requires condition(_from, _value)
transferFrom performs unchecked balanceOf[_from] -= _value
transferFrom performs unchecked balanceOf[_to] += _value
transferFrom performs unchecked allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value
batchSend performs unchecked balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total
batchSend loop performs unchecked balanceOf[_to] += _value
batchSend computes total = _value * _tos.length which can overflow
_mints assigns addedValue*(10**decimals) to balanceOf with no safe math
delegate executes a.delegatecall(b), invoking arbitrary external code with full storage control
